per_candidate.id: s2:ELVES-Dwarf. I. Satellite Systems of Eight Isolated Dwarf Galaxies in the Local

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the comparison of low-mass dark-matter halos in the LCDM model with observed properties of dwarf galaxies, nor do they address the implications for the $H_0$ tension or black hole spin. They are related to the broader topic but do not engage with the specific question posed.
